name: Intercom (Fin)
summary: Customer service platform, acquired by Salesforce on 2026-09-10; the published terms still name Intercom, Inc. as the contracting party. Fin is the vendor's AI customer agent, which resolves customer conversations without a person and reports a resolution rate. For agents, a hosted MCP server at mcp.intercom.com (US) and mcp.eu.intercom.com (EU) over the workspace's data, authorized by OAuth, and a Fin Agent API by which another agent calls Fin to answer, run a procedure or escalate; access to that API is by request. Measured: MCP initialize and the REST API answer 401 with no credentials.

payments.notes: 2026-09-20: no surface read speaks a 402 payment protocol; the MCP server and the REST API refuse a stranger with 401 OAuth, not with a price. How a human pays is not stated: the pricing page says you add payment details without naming a method, and the billing help articles answer 404.

agentAccess.notes: Re-measured 2026-09-20 18:12Z, no credentials: MCP initialize at mcp.intercom.com/mcp still 401, Bearer realm OAuth, invalid_token; api.intercom.io 401. Neither RFC 9728 well-known path exists (404); /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server at the origin answers 200. Fin Agent API access on request.

jobs.summary: Fin, the vendor's words on fin.ai: "industry leading resolution rates, averaging 76% across 12,000+ customers"; "Fin updates accounts, processes payments and refunds, troubleshoots technical issues". On fin.ai/pricing: "$0.99 per Fin outcome."; "Qualifications are $9.99 each." Not measured.
